headline: From Today We Choose How Our Second Pension Grows. The Three Options Explained Simply - Society — Standart News
summary: Bulgarian savers can now choose how their second pension pillar grows, with three options and a three-month decision window. The choice is not mandatory, and accumulated funds are not lost.
why: Second-pillar pension funds are mandatory private savings schemes that invest contributions in financial markets.
